Name: Zadok, Son of Azariah
Summary: Son of Ahitub and priest in Aaron's line.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 6:12; 1 Chronicles 6:53: Son of Ahitub and priest in Aaron's line.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Zadok stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
